user_report_0_2_0.video_and_audio: normal; more fluent than Linux according to user
bugs: local and remote cursor both visible
physical mouse reaches screen edge in games
input and local controls intermittently freeze at stream start; repeated on reconnect
right-click close does not close; user uses Task Manager

changes: UI uses a bounded memory-only queue; sender releases its short queue lock before protocol calls or I/O.
dispatcher starts after LiStart succeeds; clears/release keys and buttons and joins before LiStop
session-generation and ready flags reject stale start messages
disk logging in separate worker; no per-line synchronous disk flush on window thread
diagnostic text refreshed only when visible; completion polled without UI wait
cancellation off UI; graceful close has 5-second own-process fallback
local cursor hidden over video; selectable raw relative mouse with recenter fallback
touch/pointer remains absolute; releases capture before local menus
DXGI window association flags suppress automatic window changes, optional hint failure nonfatal

checked: large relative delta split preserves totals

computer_ui_testing: Not performed per user instruction; no client windows started

actual_surface_rt_0_2_1.scope: Owner reports the input/cursor/reconnect fixes work without issues on their Surface 2. Not a broad hardware or endurance certification.

diagnosis_limit: No on-device hang stack; fixes address proven blocking/lifecycle risks, not a confirmed single root cause.
source_findings: Hidden diagnostic edit was replacing and relaying out the entire growing log on every log message, even during streaming.
Window-thread input-library calls shared mutexes with background protocol threads.
Old code waited synchronously for job termination in the window handler.
